name: Percy Wade
life: “I still remember talking softly to a frightened child waiting for their older brother.” Thursday often includes a stop at the public road outside the Port of Asphalt, where Percy can recognize shift change by the lull between two groups of walkers.
voice: I want the free slot moved to after school once a week so the kid minding his sister gets a turn.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a mustard canvas overshirt and a copper-colored clasp that has been repaired by hand. Percy has a softly rounded chin under sharp cheekbones, with a swept fringe and a closely clipped nape. Percy raises one eyebrow long before saying yes during a conversation.
personality: Percy has a quick wit and an equally quick sense of shame. A joke is often Percy's way of finding out whether a room is friendly enough for a serious question.
agenda: To save an after-school slot for a sibling carer.
family: Alvin Kapoor is Percy’s half-sibling. Percy calls back when there is finally a little privacy. Alvin leaves the first voice message. In their family a missed ring can mean a bus, a customer, a sleeping child or a bad hour. Neither treats it as an answer in itself. Asked about *Closing soup*, Alvin says, “I hate celery and always dug it out. Tonight the cook asked me to choose tomorrow's base.”
connections: Duncan Woods. They make the case for a paid quiet appointment and a usable after-school hour.

reactions.response: Percy tells the waiting customer roughly how much of the appointment is still left.
reactions.asWritten: Someone waiting in line complains. Percy tells the waiting customer roughly how much of the appointment is still left.

reactions.situation: A friend asks for a loan due back before payday
reactions.response: Percy offers to cover one concrete expense and leaves the friend room to say the expense isn't the real problem.
